parameters.question: The dataset under analysis pertains to non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and contains 1,901 cells and 36,601 genes. After quality control and preprocessing, 96.4% of cells and 71.2% of genes were retained, indicating a high-quality dataset with minimal noise. The UMAP embedding generated 15 clusters, with the largest three clusters containing 298, 258, and 220 cells respectively. These dominant cell populations should guide the selection of marker genes, with a focus on identifying unique markers that can distinguish between these clusters. yes emphasise certain cell types

CD4+ T cells.rationale: CD4, CD3E, CD2, and IL7R are canonical markers for CD4+ T cells. CD8A and CD19 are negative markers to exclude CD8+ T cells and B cells respectively.

CD8+ T cells.rationale: CD8A, CD3E, CD2, and GZMB are canonical markers for CD8+ T cells. CD4 and CD19 are negative markers to exclude CD4+ T cells and B cells respectively.

Regulatory T cells.rationale: FOXP3, CD4, CD25, and CTLA4 are canonical markers for Regulatory T cells. CD8A and CD19 are negative markers to exclude CD8+ T cells and B cells respectively.

B cells.rationale: CD19, CD79A, MS4A1, and IGHD are canonical markers for B cells. CD3E and CD8A are negative markers to exclude T cells.

Plasma cells.rationale: CD138, CD38, IGHG1, and XBP1 are canonical markers for Plasma cells. CD19 and CD3E are negative markers to exclude B cells and T cells respectively.

NK cells.rationale: NCAM1, KLRD1, NKG7, and PRF1 are canonical markers for NK cells. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells respectively.

Monocytes/macrophages.rationale: CD68, CD14, CD163, and CSF1R are canonical markers for Monocytes/macrophages. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells respectively.

Dendritic cells.rationale: CD11C, CD209, HLA-DRA, and CD83 are canonical markers for Dendritic cells. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells respectively.

Endothelial cells.rationale: PECAM1, CDH5, VEGFR2, and VWF are canonical markers for Endothelial cells. CD45 and EPCAM are negative markers to exclude hematopoietic and epithelial cells respectively.

Fibroblasts / CAFs.rationale: ACTA2, COL1A1, FAP, and PDGFRB are canonical markers for Fibroblasts / CAFs. CD45 and EPCAM are negative markers to exclude hematopoietic and epithelial cells respectively.

Pericytes.rationale: PDGFRB, RGS5, ACTA2, and CSPG4 are canonical markers for Pericytes. CD45 and EPCAM are negative markers to exclude hematopoietic and epithelial cells respectively.

Mast cells.rationale: KIT, FCER1A, CPA3, and TPSAB1 are canonical markers for Mast cells. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells respectively.
